intent: Reuse existing CoTurtle, prior-art, QA, safety, UX and receiver contracts at the appropriate stage/risk without creating a council for every idea

prior_sources.role: prior bounded recursion and promotion ladder
CHALLENGE EXPLORATION WEIRD REPLAY FAULT reserved candidate lanes
prior art visible, falsification and public send boundary
existing launch status and explicit unproved gates
existing OBSERVE, PROPOSE, REVIEW_CHALLENGE and effect-gated actions

stages.purpose: Name one receiver need and intended benefit
stages.proof: Identity, owner, privacy, original source, epistemic class, desired effect, first useful task
Earlier CoCivium artifact comparison, relevant external priors, date, search limits, third-party rights and novelty downgrade

stages.purpose: Define a bounded alternative, threat model and fallback
stages.proof: Inputs/outputs, permission ceiling, failure domains, external effects, alternatives and falsifier
Exact source and dependencies, author, licence, build recipe and no-clobber target

stages.purpose: Prove only what real tests measured
stages.proof: Bounded deterministic tests, one failure test, baseline, observed result, nonclaims and rollback

stages.purpose: Challenge reviewer and artifact under shared limits
stages.proof: Counterargument, challenge provenance, depth/rounds/budget, retained dissent and next falsifier

stages.purpose: Exercise one no-effect candidate against a baseline
stages.proof: No hidden effects, cost, latency, correct output, explicit stop and recovery

stages.purpose: Test usefulness and independent receiver custody
stages.proof: Consenting outsider task success plus independent exact-object receiver readproof where receiver/custody is claimed

stages.purpose: Release a true version with accessible correction
stages.proof: Owner authorizes, rights checked, public security, current version/URL, channel compliance, correction and rollback

stages.purpose: Observe bounded usefulness and failure safely
stages.proof: Real heartbeat/lease, logs with privacy, feedback/corrections, measured cost, incident/takedown controls

stages.purpose: Preserve lineage or prove requested deletion
stages.proof: Export or exact archive, receiver restore, licence retention, secret/PII deletion boundary, revocation and successor

lanes.purpose: Provenance, historical CoCivium priors, falsifiable scope and cited evidence
Earlier CoCivium and external literature, designs, standards and dated searches
Licence, third-party assets, trademark, disclosure and qualified patent counsel where required
Threat model, alternatives, dependencies, collision domains and portable work identities
Unit, integration, negative, fuzz/fault, regressions and measured acceptance bounds
lanes.decision_not: release merely from a pass count

lanes.purpose: CoTurtle challenger, counterfactual, CoDvl and dissent preserved
Secrets/PII, safety, access boundaries, supply-chain, incident and withdrawal
Pinned input/licence/manifests, provenance and reproducible build receipts
Keyboard, screenreader, mobile, reduced motion and graceful fallback
Leases, heartbeat, duplicate-execution isolation, restore, rollback and failure-domain test
One clear useful task, consenting independent evaluation, correction burden and opt-out
Truthful scope, attribution, privacy, channel consent and explicit no-endorsement

LOW_PUBLIC_DOC.baseline: Provenance, basic tests or cited facts, typo/accessibility pass, optional challenge

SOFTWARE_EFFECTFUL.baseline: Risk and threat scope, deterministic/fault tests, rollback, isolated micro-canary, activity receipt

PRIVACY_OR_SECURITY.baseline: Independent security/privacy review, data-minimization, revocation and incident plan

PUBLIC_OR_BULK_COMMUNICATION.baseline: Source/currentness, authorized route, deliverability, consent/rights and actual receiver distinction

SCIENTIFIC_OR_HIGH_IMPACT_CLAIM.baseline: Prior-art search, counterexamples, competing explanations, reproducibility and explicit uncertainty

FINANCIAL_OR_LEGAL.baseline: Information class, owner scope, professional/jurisdictional gate, reversible analysis separate from action

HUMAN_SAFETY.baseline: Professional/affected-person safety review, off-switch, physical risk and incident plan

reviewer_independence.SELF_CHECK: Can satisfy preliminary mechanical gate only
reviewer_independence.MULTI_AGENT_SAME_SOURCE: Advisory challenge; does not constitute independent human review or independent evidence
reviewer_independence.INDEPENDENT_AI_SUBSTRATE: May diversify tests but shared data/assumptions still require independence audit
reviewer_independence.INDEPENDENT_PERSON: Can provide independent task/review evidence when identity, consent, source and scope established
reviewer_independence.QUALIFIED_PROFESSIONAL: Needed for gated domain advice/filings or effectful regulated actions
reviewer_independence.RECEIVER: Only elected receiver-produced exact readback counts as pickup proof

technical_threshold_watchlist.requirement: Primary inbox arrival<60s with recipient-side ID
Claude credential presence<1s never log secret

external_donors.pattern: Independent security controls including branch protection, code review, token permissions
Pin inputs, artifact and builder provenance; do not self-award conformance

next_proof: A real opted-in one-task receiver and one non-GitHub cold restore, reviewed with the same source-bound stage receipt and negative counterexample
